messages:
Ravi: Quick post-launch triage for v0.9.0. We need to pick bugs vs enhancements for the 2-week minor. Can we decide by EOD? @Nora @Diego
Nora: Skimmed reports: billing mismatch (C-bill), stream truncation (C-stream), missing trace IDs in logs (C-trace). Plus 5 small UX asks. Billing looks P0.
Diego: Agree billing P0. Stream truncation happens ~0.6% of requests in prod, need more traces. Kim, can you add sampling?
Kim: Will add targeted sampling and a lightweight replay hook tonight. Also can implement the quick UX (token copy) in ~1d.
Ravi: Short rubric: P0 billing/data loss/security, P1 major correctness/regressions, P2 polish/features. Keep v0.9.1 scope tight: P0 mandatory, up to two P1s if <=3d each, include 1-2 P2 quick wins.
Nora: Owners: billing -> Nora, stream traces -> Kim, token copy -> Kim, docs fix -> Diego. Release plan: canary 48h, then 50% if green. Add billing smoke test to canary.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: canary 2026-03-27 07:00 UTC to slot canary-7 by Ravi. Tag: release/v0.9.1-canary
Diego: I'll take docs fix and help with release notes.
Ravi: Action items:
- Nora: billing fix + tests (3d)
- Kim: tracing + token copy (2d)
- Diego: docs + release notes (2d)
If no objections I'll lock scope and update board.
Nora: SGTM
Diego: SGTM
Kim: SGTM
Ravi: Locking now. Thanks!
